comportamentos: Toolbar with bold and italic buttons in the assertion (declaração) template editor: present (it uses <b>/<i>, which Prawn renders)
Alignment buttons (center/justify) in the editor: present in the UI only
Alignment markup actually applied when the PDF is rendered (official adds the align Liquid tag and parse_align_segments/print_multipage_text_with_alignments in PdfHelper): missing
Toolbar also available in the notification body template editor: missing
Multipage PDF printing that keeps markup across pages, plus escaping of query data so it is not read as markup: missing
justificativa: The candidate only adds UI buttons that insert HTML, but the PDF generator does not understand <div style="text-align">, so center/justify alignment has no effect on the generated declaration, and the rest of the official behavior is absent.
